opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers into a paid node participation process requiring an initial contribution and a recurring monthly charge. The speaker states that “you need 10 coins minimum” and that the node will cost “14.95 us dollars” each month. Those payments are tied to an income proposition: the node is described as “just another way of earning passive income,” with rewards expected to continue and increase. The speaker further explains that accumulated node money can be used to open additional nodes, reinforcing a cycle of paid participation funded by purported returns. The rewards are described as variable rather than guaranteed, and the speaker says there is no referral link, but those qualifications do not change that the video promotes paid participation for recurring income and substantial earning potential.
